name: Avio (Italy)
description: Light blue field with a yellow vertical stripe at the centre charged with the crowned municipal arms of Avio (a yellow cross on blue) within branches and the inscription COMUNE DI AVIO in black beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Avio, a comune in Trentino-South Tyrol; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Avio arms — yellow cross on blue, crowned, within branches
inscription COMUNE DI AVIO beneath the arms
